events.headline: IRAQ’S FM SAYS EXTERNAL PARTIES USING IRAQI SOIL TO ATTACK NEIGHBOURS
events.detail: Iraqi foreign minister tells Al Jazeera that Baghdad is investigating attacks on the Gulf launched from its territory.

events.headline: QESHM ISLAND AND HORMUZ HIT, AS MEDIATORS TRY TO PREVENT US-IRAN ESCALATION
events.detail: US strikes have continued on Iran after more ships in the Strait of Hormuz were attacked.
